verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs show a ready developer setup. Neovim is the default editor, with VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime Text, Helix, Vim and Emacs installable from the menu. Rails, Laravel, Node.js and other environments install from the menu, with Mise managing language versions. Claude Code and OpenCode ship as default agent harnesses, with launchers for every major coding-agent CLI. A community user confirms software installs are easy and fast. missing for 10: evidence of AI/ML frameworks or GPU compute toolchains beyond coding agents (NVIDIA drivers are mentioned only for gaming), evidence that 'latest' versions are delivered promptly, evidence that vendors treat this platform as primary or first-class, and independent hands-on corroboration of the dev tooling.
